timing: median of three warmed rounds; old/new order alternates; elapsed wall time with queue waits; not an overall model benchmark
notes: The initial event-timer run aborted because its queue lacked enable_profiling; that abort is retained.
Only the timing harness was changed to queue-synchronized wall time; precision bounds and math were not changed.
Both XMX versions refuse Q4_0 K with valid pools; this is an eligibility check, not a numerical pass.
K8V4 outputs match the original XMX but fail the existing comparison with FP64 and the original FP32 fallback.
The source aliases query/P and K/V lifetime regions and processes one output tile per subgroup at a time; requested SLM falls from 86784 to 62208 bytes.
